qualifierLines: {**20 NY3d at 1025} OPINION OF THE COURT

Defendant, facing multiple felony charges, pleaded guilty to one count of robbery in the first degree. He was adjudicated a second felony offender and was sentenced to 15 years' imprisonment, to be served concurrently with another sentence. At his 2006 plea, he was not advised that his sentence included five years of postrelease supervision. Defendant now maintains that he received ineffective assistance of appellate counsel when his attorney did not brief that issue in his 2008 direct appeal (, 8 NY3d 541 [2007]; , 4 NY3d 242 [2005]).
